meta.title: footygame: the daily football challenge
meta.description: Two footballers every day. Get from the first to the second by jumping between clubs, seasons and squad-mates.

landing.title: Two players. One path of teammates.
landing.lead: A new challenge every day: hop from club to club and squad to squad until you reach the target player.
landing.step1Text: You see every club and season they played in.
landing.step2Title: Pick a club and a season
landing.step2Text: The full squad of that year shows up.
landing.step3Title: Pick a teammate and keep going
landing.step3Text: Repeat until you reach the target player, in the least time and with the fewest jumps.
landing.rule1: You get 20 jumps at most. Every pick counts as one jump.
landing.rule2: The clock starts with Start and never stops.
landing.rule3: To go back, pick the previous node again. That also counts as a jump.
landing.rule4: There is one challenge per day, the same for everyone.
landing.dataText: Squads from 10 leagues: Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Argentina, Brazil, Portugal, Netherlands and MLS. They cover 2012/13 to 2025/26, except Argentina, Brazil and MLS, which only have 2024 and 2025.
landing.footer: Independent project, not affiliated with any club, league or player. Open data derived from Transfermarkt (CC0 license). Photos are replaced by initials.
